Everyday texts

Read signs and notices accurately

Turn short public messages into the correct action by combining wording, symbols and context.

Official sources checked: 2026-09-19

Find the instruction word

Look for verbs such as keep, use, wait, report, close or do not enter. They tell you the expected action.

Notice restrictions

Words such as only, except, before, after and until change who the notice applies to and when.

01PURPOSE02CLUE03EVIDENCE04ANSWER

Use symbols as support

A symbol can reinforce the message, but read the words when they are present. Similar icons may have different meanings in different places.

Restate the message

Before choosing an answer, say the notice in simple language: who, what action, where and when.
